choices.content: Compare only the highest score in each class.
Compare only the number of students in each class.
Use the mean to compare overall performance and the variance to compare consistency.
Compare only the lowest score in each class.

question.prompt: How should the physical fitness test scores of two classes be compared?

solutions.explanation: The mean reflects the overall level, while the variance reflects the degree of variability (consistency) in the data. Both are needed for a comprehensive comparison.
solutions.title: Interpret the two statistics
